correctness.rationale: For all integer n>=2, the order-statistic representation and exact conditioning on minimum/maximum give the displayed quadratic conditional expectation. Uniformity of the minimum conditional on the range and Beta(n-1,2) moments produce the covariance. Differentiation gives an interior unique minimizer and crossings. Degenerate pair empirical-process decomposition yields Var(W)=(4n-3)/(180n), and hence the exact correlation. Every boundary is specified and 48 independently constructed exact-rational checks through n=7 passed; those checks do not substitute for the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The coupling of sample range (endpoint spread) to the integrated empirical-CDF deviation is a natural joint calibration problem for two distinct uniformity diagnostics. The exact U-shaped regression, precise interior minimum and crossing despite negative covariance reveal a nonmonotone dependence mechanism not implied by marginal CvM and beta-range laws. The exact correlation and inverse-n decorrelation rate quantify a finite-size phenomenon useful when interpreting ostensibly concordant diagnostics.
